target.experience: Local Cataclysm gameplay with Blizzard-like behavior
scope: individual content records and required variants

coverage_rule: Separate scenario coverage, protocol inventory, and content coverage. Historical observations and opcode references do not count as current qualified passes. No combined 100-percent claim.
live_qualification: normal account and owned authenticated actor
no unexplained unmapped packet or disconnect
repeated fresh-state pass and reconnect persistence where applicable
phases: 4: exhaustive content variants and normal-timing soak

features.oracle: Valid proofs and owned native character entry; wrong credentials fail

features.scenario: Launcher SSO, ticket expiry, one-use behavior and direct-login fallback
